title: Nutgrove Park, Dublin 14, Clonskeagh, Dublin 14
description: A beautifully presented, fully furnished, A-rated terraced house (189sqm), ideally situated on a quiet and highly regarded residential road. The property enjoys an excellent location, with a number of renowned primary and secondary schools nearby, including St Killian’s, Alexandra College and Sandford Park. The area is also exceptionally well served by public transport, with Milltown Luas station approximately a 10–15 minute walk away. On entering, the bright and welcoming hallway features elegant parquet flooring, which continues throughout the entire ground floor. At the rear of the property is a magnificent open-plan living, dining and kitchen area, creating an impressive and versatile space for both everyday family living and entertaining. The modern kitchen is well equipped with ample storage, an electric hob, a rayburn stove,  dishwasher and a range of additional appliances. Double doors open directly onto the west-facing rear garden and patio, providing an excellent outdoor extension of the living space. To the front of the house is a beautifully proportioned drawing room and dining room, featuring a charming open fireplace and attractive box bay window. The ground floor also benefits from a home office or potential guest bedroom, together with a shower room and a large utility room equipped with washing machine and dryer. Upstairs, there are four generous double bedrooms, along with a fully tiled shower room and a separate guest WC. The property benefits from an energy-efficient heat pump heating system and combines generous accommodation, elegant period-style features and modern comforts in a highly sought-after residential setting.
